title: Sniper Decoys: Dummy Heads
author: Simple History
shortDescription:
The job of making decoy heads out of paper mache was entrusted to camouflage units, who were working in their small improvised workshops   on the front lines. 
Sculptors working in these workshops made a huge variety of decoy heads with great precision and resemblance to real human heads.
